findings.title: Exhaustive counting turns completed action into present encounter
findings.claim: The focus presents exhaustive counting as the operation through which completed intentional acts become objects encountered in the present scene.
findings.mechanism: The small-great range is gathered by the count carrier; the action and finding carriers connect what was done to what is encountered, while supplied wider record parallels return the same operation through the placed Book.
findings.reader_payoff: The record becomes perceptible as an active disclosure of each completed act, not only as a statement that deeds were once written down.
findings.containment: The ordinary written-record and accountability reading remains intact. The pebble branch is retained as a qualified granular image, not as a claim that the verse literally names stones; the wider connections supply resonance without reconstruction of their missing target morphology.

epistemic.reason: The focus-anchored publication is trusted and names all four branches; the global extension is qualified because the wider target rows provide exact Arabic and relation notes but not target morphology, and the pebble facet is contextual.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Past acts become retrievable as separate, countable items gathered into present disclosure.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a qualified pebble-like image, not a literal stone reference and not an activation of the branch's unrelated physical-landscape facets.

findings.title: Agency is encountered as its own trace
findings.claim: The focus's paired action and finding words make completed agency the thing later encountered as present.
findings.mechanism: The finding verb takes whatever they did as its complement, and the present-state word marks that completed action as on hand; the supplied 18:36 connection supplies the contrast with an imagined favorable return.
findings.reader_payoff: The record reads as disclosure of what the agents made, rather than as an external accusation added to them.
findings.containment: The relation does not say that the record manufactures guilt, that the agents' later outcome is settled here, or that the ordinary written-record sense is displaced. The 18:36 link is a qualified same-surah contrast.

epistemic.reason: The legacy reader walk has exact focus branch support and the connection supplies exact target Arabic, but its source is unbound and the target morphology is not supplied.

findings.reader_payoff: Each deed can be imagined as retrievable in its own right, so completeness becomes a texture of the scene rather than only a total claim.
findings.containment: The pebble reading remains a qualified image of granularity and does not turn the counted deeds into literal stones. The focus remains about complete accounting; the wider rows have exact Arabic but no supplied target morphology.

findings.title: Presence is not the same as weight
findings.claim: The wider surah separates encountering works from their later valuation: the focus makes deeds present, while supplied later verses show that works can still lose weight.
findings.mechanism: The focus's finding and presentness carriers make completed works available for encounter; the supplied 18:103 and 18:105 connections return through the same deed field with the later language of failed works and absent weight.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold disclosure and judgment together without treating present evidence as an automatic promise of saving value.
findings.containment: The later verses do not erase the focus's statement that deeds are found present, and the focus does not itself announce the later condition of failed works. The relation is a same-surah counter-reading, not a choice between the two.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective support is legacy and the target rows lack supplied morphology, but both same-surah connections provide exact Arabic and an explicit focus-return relation.

findings.reader_payoff: The final assurance becomes structurally active: completeness is paired with a stated limit against wrongful accounting.
findings.containment: This does not infer a complete theology of justice, activate the root's positive uniqueness or numerical branches, or claim that the wider rows replace the focus's own closing clause. Their target morphology is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The focus surface and trusted focus-anchored record finding supply the accountability frame, while exact wider connection Arabic supplies the no-wronging parallels without target morphology.
